At some point before the end of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]],<ref name="GHSW" /> a '''Sith obelisk''' was constructed on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]]. Located in the north central regions of the planet,<ref name="POTJ">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> the [[obelisk]] was created and imbued with the power of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] by a [[Unidentified Sith sorceress|Sith sorceress]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|26|Ambria}}</ref> A [[black]]-[[Color/Legends|colored]] spike-shaped structure, the obelisk took [[Standard century/Legends|hundreds]] of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to build at the behest of the [[Sith sorcerer|sorceress]], who depleted much of Ambria's natural resources and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] the planet's native [[Species/Legends|inhabitants]].<ref name="TOTJ" /> Upon completing the obelisk,<ref name="POTJ" /> the sorceress conducted a complicated [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Force power/Legends|ritual]], harnessing an immense amount of dark side energy in an attempt to bind the entire world to her will. The sorceress was [[Death/Legends|killed]],<ref name="DOE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref> however, after she lost control of the power that was [[Devastation of Ambria|unleashed]] upon Ambria,<ref name="POTJ" /> destroying all living beings on the planet and infusing what remained with the dark side.<ref name="TOTJ" />
